title: Shopping Cart in Gallery
description: A realistic painting of a metal shopping cart standing alone in the center of an empty modern art gallery. The cart contains crumpled papers, a large green leaf, and a very long receipt trailing onto the concrete floor beside a discarded coffee cup.
prompt: A solitary metal shopping cart stands in the middle of a spacious, minimalist contemporary art gallery with concrete floors and large abstract paintings on white walls. Inside the cart are crumpled papers and a prominent green leaf. A very long white receipt unspools from the cart onto the floor next to a small paper coffee cup. Dramatic overhead lighting creates soft shadows, realistic painting style, muted color palette, contemplative atmosphere.
